_comment: Stage-11 VEX baseline. CycloneDX 1.5 vulnerabilities[] schema.
What this file is:
A hand-curated, defensible baseline of known-vulnerable
dependencies in the vOS.v1 supply chain as of 2026-05-09.
Each entry binds a CVE/GHSA id to one or more bom-refs and
carries a triage decision (analysis.state + justification).
What this file is NOT:
A live vulnerability scan. Production CI replaces this file
with the merged output of pip-audit + npm audit + cargo-audit
(each tool has its own sub-schema; the merger is documented
in docs/SIGSTORE_V3_GAP.md §3 'VEX live-feed integration').
Why a baseline still matters when CI overwrites it:
If the CI pipeline fails or is bypassed, the published SBOM
still carries a non-empty (and therefore reviewable) VEX
section. An auditor seeing 'vulnerabilities: []' cannot
distinguish 'no known CVEs' from 'audit step failed silently'.
This baseline guarantees the section is always meaningful.
Triage convention for new entries:
state=under_investigation is the default for any newly-added
entry; the security review board moves it to one of
{not_affected, affected, fixed, false_positive} after
evaluating the call graph. Empty justification on a
not_affected entry MUST be rejected at PR review.

vulnerabilities.description: Sentinel entry: this is not a real advisory. Its purpose is to demonstrate the schema an auditor reads — and to prove the SBOM tool emits a non-empty vulnerabilities array even before a live scan runs.
